record.title: Violent Crimes (Noun-voice tribute)
record.dek: A 12-bar tribute re-harmonized for the chime engine. Every Noun mints its own chord; the run is different every time you hit play.
record.body: Built around 'Violent Crimes' from Ye (2018). Loop = on, BPM = 90 default, three voices stack on chorus. Hit share to preserve a specific seed.
